name: Nose of the Bear
body:
Your sensitive sense of smell allows you to locate and track enemies.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is the god of bears or werebears.

Benefit: You gain the Scent (Ex) ability.

The Book of Divine Magic. Copyright 2009, 4 Winds Fantasy Gaming; Authors Connie J. Thomson and Robert W. Thomson, with Katheryn Bauer and Sean O’Connor.
